redteam_note: Scored >0 but NO source cited — unsupported claim, verify first. No data year recorded — provenance/recency unknown.
revision_notes: IMF reporting shows total tax revenue at only ~8% of GDP in 2024 (DGCI domestic taxes 3.8% of GDP) — the lowest tax effort in ECOWAS — against a large informal, agriculture-based economy, with the IMF's 2020 governance report citing 'weak information technology systems' at the revenue authority. A digital tax portal (Kontaktu) and an automated NIF/TIN link with the business registry (CFE) exist, but registered-business coverage remains very low given the narrow formal tax base. Value Code 1 (<20%) confirmed, year 2024/2025.
